title: Ledger Accounting Note: Start of Accumulation Interest Paid With a Whole Life Insurance Surrender
content:
Interest on the dividend accumulations paid with the full surrender of an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy runs to the surrender effective date from a start date that the ledger fixes:

1. where an accumulation withdrawal is dated after the most recent anniversary, from the date of the latest such withdrawal;
2. where no withdrawal is so dated but a dividend deposit entry is, from the date of the latest such deposit;
3. otherwise, from the most recent anniversary.

The most recent anniversary is the anniversary the posted cash values are as of. A deposit entry dated on the anniversary itself is not after it.

## Ledger cases (hypothetical, most recent anniversary March 1, 2025, surrender effective July 10, 2025)

| Withdrawals after March 1, 2025 | Deposit entries after March 1, 2025 | Interest runs from | Days to July 10 |
|---|---|---|---|
| April 14, 2025 | May 2, 2025 | April 14, 2025 | 87 |
| None | May 2, 2025 | May 2, 2025 | 69 |
| None | None | March 1, 2025 | 131 |
